name: SpawnAtlas
description: Gaming discovery platform mapping places, tournaments, communities and gear across Africa, by Trigenys.
brief: SpawnAtlas is a gaming discovery product, not a generic landing page. It helps players find where to play, tournaments, communities, gaming stores, repairers, gear prices and PC builds. Cameroon launch: Douala, Yaoundé and Dschang. Brand: warm African gaming identity with charcoal #0E0D0B, coral #FF6A3D, amber #FFB84D, discovery green #B8F247 and sand #F8EAD9. Tagline: Find where Africa plays.
